name: criv-obsidian-plugin
description: Obsidian companion plugin for criv vault state.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:plugin
scripts.build:wasm: mise exec cargo:wasm-pack@0.15.0 -- wasm-pack build ../../../crates/criv-wasm --target bundler --out-dir ../../.obsidian/plugins/criv/pkg
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test: node test/core.test.mjs && node test/version-bump.test.mjs && node test/main.test.mjs
